description: Refined discriminator test: side-chain contacts to adenine vs uridine bases in 1RGO, combined with a TTP-family-restricted nematode variability scan
code:
# ============================================================================
# Iteration 2, analysis 3 (refinement of analysis 2, which failed to
# discriminate because the whole-Nematoda CCCH set is too heterogeneous).
#
# Three independent criteria a Pagano "discriminator" position must satisfy:
#   1. Its side chain contacts an adenine base in 1RGO. MEX-5 binds poly-U
#      while TTP requires the A of UAUU, so the residue that sets that
#      difference must read the adenine, not the uridines.
#   2. MEX-5 differs from the invariant metazoan residue at the equivalent
#      position in BOTH fingers (the paper mutates one residue per finger).
#   3. The position is variable among TTP-family nematode TZF proteins and
#      invariant among non-nematode metazoan TTP-family proteins.
# ============================================================================
import re, collections
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA3TO1 = {"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G",
          "HIS":"H","ILE":"I","LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S",
          "THR":"T","TRP":"W","TYR":"Y","VAL":"V"}
RNA_BB = {"P","OP1","OP2","O5'","C5'","C4'","O4'","C3'","O3'","C2'","O2'","C1'"}
MAIN = {"N","CA","C","O","OXT"}
OFFSETS = [("C1",-6),("C1",-4),("C1",-3),("C1",-2),("C1",-1),("C1",0),("C1",1),("C1",2),
           ("C2",0),("C2",1),("C2",2),("C3",-1),("C3",0),("C3",1),("C3",2)]
AI = {"C1":0,"C2":1,"C3":2,"H":3}
T_ZF1 = {("C1",-6):153,("C1",-4):155,("C1",-3):156,("C1",-2):157,("C1",-1):158,("C1",0):159,
         ("C1",1):160,("C1",2):161,("C2",0):168,("C2",1):169,("C2",2):170,("C3",-1):173,
         ("C3",0):174,("C3",1):175,("C3",2):176}

# ---------------------------------------------------- 1RGO, side-chain contacts
txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb", timeout=120).text
models = collections.defaultdict(list); cur = None
for line in txt.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith("MODEL"): cur = int(line.split()[1])
    elif line.startswith("ENDMDL"): cur = None
    elif cur and line.startswith("ATOM"):
        if (line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]) == "H": continue
        models[cur].append((line[21], int(line[22:26]), line[17:20].strip(), line[12:16].strip(),
                            float(line[30:38]), float(line[38:46]), float(line[46:54])))
nm = len(models)
rna_seq = {a[1]: a[2] for a in models[1] if a[0] == "D"}
print("1RGO RNA chain D:", "".join(rna_seq[k] for k in sorted(rna_seq)), sorted(rna_seq.items()))

sc_A, sc_U, sc_any_base, polar_A = (collections.Counter() for _ in range(4))
POLAR = lambda n: n[0] in "NO"
for atoms in models.values():
    prot = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "A"]; rna = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "D"]
    P = np.array([a[4:7] for a in prot]); Q = np.array([a[4:7] for a in rna])
    D = np.linalg.norm(P[:, None] - Q[None], axis=2)
    seen = {k: set() for k in ("A", "U", "base", "polA")}
    for i, j in zip(*np.where(D < 4.0)):
        if prot[i][3] in MAIN or prot[i][2] == "GLY": continue      # side chain only
        if rna[j][3] in RNA_BB: continue                            # base atoms only
        seen["base"].add(prot[i][1])
        if rna[j][2].strip() in ("A", "ADE"): seen["A"].add(prot[i][1])
        else: seen["U"].add(prot[i][1])
    for i, j in zip(*np.where(D < 3.6)):
        if prot[i][3] in MAIN or rna[j][3] in RNA_BB: continue
        if POLAR(prot[i][3]) and POLAR(rna[j][3]) and rna[j][2].strip() in ("A", "ADE"):
            seen["polA"].add(prot[i][1])
    for r in seen["A"]: sc_A[r] += 1
    for r in seen["U"]: sc_U[r] += 1
    for r in seen["base"]: sc_any_base[r] += 1
    for r in seen["polA"]: polar_A[r] += 1

# ------------------------------------------------- sequence sets, TTP-restricted
ZF_RE = re.compile(r"(?=(C.{7,12}C.{4,6}C.{2,4}H))")
def find_fingers(seq):
    out = {}
    for m in ZF_RE.finditer(seq):
        inner = re.match(r"C(.{7,12}?)C(.{4,6}?)C(.{2,4}?)H$", m.group(1))
        if not inner: continue
        s = m.start()+1; l1, l2, l3 = (len(g) for g in inner.groups())
        out.setdefault(s, (s, s+1+l1, s+2+l1+l2, s+3+l1+l2+l3))
    return sorted(out.values())

def up_fasta(query, size=400):
    r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
                     params={"query": query, "format": "fasta", "size": size}, timeout=240)
    r.raise_for_status(); seqs, k = {}, None
    for line in r.text.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith(">"): k = line.split("|")[1] if "|" in line else line[1:20]; seqs[k] = ""
        elif k: seqs[k] += line.strip()
    return seqs

def positions(seq, f1, f2):
    col = []
    for f in (f1, f2):
        for o in OFFSETS:
            p = f[AI[o[0]]] + o[1]
            if p < 1 or p > len(seq): return None
            col.append(seq[p-1])
    return col

def harvest(raw):
    out = {}
    for acc, s in raw.items():
        f = find_fingers(s)
        for i in range(len(f)-1):
            lk = f[i+1][0] - f[i][3] - 1
            if 14 <= lk <= 30:
                c = positions(s, f[i], f[i+1])
                if c: out[acc] = c
                break
    return out

META = harvest(up_fasta("(gene:ZFP36 OR gene:ZFP36L1 OR gene:ZFP36L2 OR gene:ZFP36L3 OR gene:Tis11) "
                        "AND reviewed:true AND taxonomy_id:33208 NOT taxonomy_id:6231"))
NEM_ALL = harvest(up_fasta("taxonomy_id:6231 AND xref:interpro-IPR000571", 400))
Mdf = pd.DataFrame(META)
tis11d = Mdf["P47974"] if "P47974" in Mdf else Mdf.iloc[:, 0]

# restrict nematode set to TTP-family-like sequences, then collapse near-duplicates
NEM = {a: c for a, c in NEM_ALL.items() if sum(x == y for x, y in zip(c, tis11d)) >= 15}
uniq, seen = {}, set()
for a, c in NEM.items():
    k = "".join(c)
    if k not in seen: seen.add(k); uniq[a] = c
Ndf = pd.DataFrame(uniq)
print(f"metazoan TTP family: {Mdf.shape[1]}; nematode CCCH tandem: {len(NEM_ALL)}; "
      f"TTP-family-like (>=15/30 identity to TIS11d): {len(NEM)}; distinct 30-mers: {Ndf.shape[1]}")

labels = [f"ZF{fi+1} {o[0]}{o[1]:+d}" for fi in (0,1) for o in OFFSETS]
tisnum = [T_ZF1[o] + 38*fi for fi in (0,1) for o in OFFSETS]
mex5 = positions(*(lambda s: (s,) + tuple(find_fingers(s)[:2]))(
    "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9XUB2.fasta", timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])))
mex6 = positions(*(lambda s: (s,) + tuple(find_fingers(s)[:2]))(
    "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q09436.fasta", timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])))

rows = []
for i, lab in enumerate(labels):
    mv = Mdf.iloc[i].value_counts(); nv = Ndf.iloc[i].value_counts()
    t = tisnum[i]
    rows.append({"position": lab, "TIS11d_num": t, "TIS11d_aa": tis11d[i],
                 "metazoan_invariant": len(mv) == 1, "metazoan_aa": mv.index[0],
                 "nem_major_frac": nv.iloc[0]/nv.sum(), "nem_n_aa": len(nv),
                 "MEX5": mex5[i], "MEX6": mex6[i],
                 "mex5_differs_from_metazoan": mex5[i] != mv.index[0],
                 "sc_adenine_freq": sc_A[t]/nm, "sc_uridine_freq": sc_U[t]/nm,
                 "polar_sc_adenine_freq": polar_A[t]/nm})
R = pd.DataFrame(rows)
# criterion 2 requires the same position to differ in BOTH fingers
pos_name = [l.split(" ", 1)[1] for l in labels]
R["offset"] = pos_name
both = R.groupby("offset")["mex5_differs_from_metazoan"].all()
R["mex5_differs_both_fingers"] = R["offset"].map(both)
R["metazoan_invariant_both"] = R["offset"].map(R.groupby("offset")["metazoan_invariant"].all())
R["sc_adenine_both"] = R["offset"].map(R.groupby("offset")["sc_adenine_freq"].min() > 0.5)
R["nem_variable_both"] = R["offset"].map(R.groupby("offset")["nem_major_frac"].max() < 0.9)
R.to_csv("discriminator_three_criteria.csv", index=False)

cand = R[R["mex5_differs_both_fingers"] & R["metazoan_invariant_both"] & R["nem_variable_both"]]
print("\ncriteria 2+3 (MEX-5 differs in both fingers, metazoan-invariant, nematode-variable):")
print(cand[["position","TIS11d_num","TIS11d_aa","MEX5","MEX6","sc_adenine_freq",
            "sc_uridine_freq","polar_sc_adenine_freq","nem_n_aa"]].to_string(index=False))
final = cand[cand["sc_adenine_both"]]
print("\n=== plus criterion 1 (side chain reads an adenine base in >50% of models) ===")
print(final[["position","TIS11d_num","TIS11d_aa","MEX5","MEX6","sc_adenine_freq",
             "polar_sc_adenine_freq"]].to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.4))
x = np.arange(len(R))
ax[0].bar(x-0.2, R["sc_adenine_freq"], 0.4, color="#b03030", label="side chain to adenine base")
ax[0].bar(x+0.2, R["sc_uridine_freq"], 0.4, color="#2b5d8c", label="side chain to uridine base")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(R["position"], rotation=90, fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction of the 20 NMR models"); ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1.1)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("Criterion 1: which TIS11d side chains read an adenine\n(PDB 1RGO, 4 A, side-chain to base atoms only)")
for i in final.index: ax[0].annotate("*", (i, 1.02), ha="center", fontsize=14, color="#b03030")

ok = R["mex5_differs_both_fingers"] & R["metazoan_invariant_both"] & R["nem_variable_both"]
ax[1].scatter(R["sc_adenine_freq"], 1-R["nem_major_frac"], s=70,
              c=["#b03030" if v else "#b9c4d2" for v in ok], edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.4)
for i in R.index:
    if ok[i] or R["sc_adenine_freq"][i] > 0.5:
        ax[1].annotate(f"{R['position'][i]} ({R['TIS11d_aa'][i]}{R['TIS11d_num'][i]}"
                       f"→{R['MEX5'][i]}/{R['MEX6'][i]})",
                       (R["sc_adenine_freq"][i], 1-R["nem_major_frac"][i]),
                       fontsize=7.5, xytext=(4, 4), textcoords="offset points")
ax[1].set_xlabel("side-chain contact frequency to an adenine base")
ax[1].set_ylabel("variability among TTP-family nematode TZF sequences\n(1 - frequency of the most common residue)")
ax[1].set_title("Red: positions where MEX-5 differs from the invariant metazoan\n"
                f"residue in both fingers and the position varies in {Ndf.shape[1]} nematode sequences")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
